exit_share_count.override_rule: replace with the point-in-time DILUTED count — this basic count plus the dilutive increment stated from the filing (options and RSUs by the treasury-stock method, convertibles if-converted) — or with a reliable, explicit forward share-count forecast on that basis; never the diluted weighted average, which is a period average

non_operating_assets.reason: the primary current and historical EV multiple series use the vendor's TEV definition, which carries non-operating investments inside enterprise value; carving them out of the bridge alone would value a different enterprise than the one the multiple was struck on
non_operating_assets.adjustment_condition: only if BOTH the current and the historical valuation series are rebuilt consistently on the adjusted operating-EV basis — a separate, consistently rebased framework, never a carve-out in the bridge alone

date_semantics.reference_date_semantics: the screening/reference date the page was assembled against — NOT the freshness date of its inputs; each input's own date is named in this block
date_semantics.analysis_as_of_rule: the latest of price_as_of, market_cap_as_of, tev_as_of, consensus_as_of (a '≥' date counts at its floor), balance_sheet_date and historical_multiple_latest_observation

data_quality_detail: lease basis: rent 8.3% of EBITDA (FY ending 2026-01-31: $667M of $8,072M) — material (≥5%); R1 uses the ex-lease history; EDGAR LeaseCost that year: $898M
recorded-D&A check not run: it tests CIQ's Multiples-sheet ratios, which the ex-lease history does not use

margin.source: EDGAR companyfacts OperatingIncomeLoss / RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax — reported median over 10 FY

multiple.source: valuation.lease_basis.ex_lease_band.median — TEV less operating leases over reported LTM EBITDA, the basis of the EBITDA R1 prices

net_debt.source: EDGAR: total debt incl. finance leases 15,357 − cash 5,411 ($M); operating leases 3,704 EXCLUDED — the multiple is struck on TEV less operating leases

shares_outstanding.basis: point-in-time shares outstanding — the per-share denominator (item 24)
shares_outstanding.source: mechanical.stock_info.shares_out (EDGAR XBRL shares outstanding); 0.0% below the filer's basic weighted average 454,400,000 (2026-05-03..2026-08-01)

dilutive_increment.basis: diluted less basic weighted average over the latest 10-Q quarter — the dilution test

ltm_fcf.source: EDGAR companyfacts operating_cash_flow − capex (FY2025, same period)
